---
title: "Gallery"
description: "MEEM Lab gallery: fieldwork, conferences, and lab activities at Victoria University of Wellington."
keywords: [gallery, fieldwork, conferences, marine ecology, Wellington, New Zealand, lab activities]
---

Welcome to the MEEM Lab photo gallery! Here are some highlights of our team presenting at conferences, working in the field, and collaborating together.

```{r print-gallery, echo=FALSE, results='asis'}
library(yaml)
gallery_dir <- "images/gallery"
images <- list.files(gallery_dir, pattern = "\\.(jpg|jpeg|png|webp|gif)$", ignore.case = TRUE)

captions_file <- file.path(gallery_dir, "captions.yml")
custom_captions <- if (file.exists(captions_file)) yaml.load_file(captions_file) else list()

cat('<div class="gallery-grid">')
for (img in images) {
  img_path <- file.path(gallery_dir, img)
  if (!is.null(custom_captions[[img]]) && nzchar(custom_captions[[img]])) {
    caption <- custom_captions[[img]]
  } else {
    caption <- tools::file_path_sans_ext(img)
    caption <- gsub("[-_]+", " ", caption)
    caption <- paste0(toupper(substring(caption, 1, 1)), substring(caption, 2))
  }
  cat(paste0(
    '<div class="gallery-item" tabindex="0">',
      '<img src="', img_path, '" alt="', caption, '" class="gallery-img">',
      '<div class="gallery-overlay"><span>', caption, '</span></div>',
    '</div>'
  ))
}
cat('</div>')
```

<style>
.gallery-grid {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: 2rem;
  justify-content: center;
}
.gallery-item {
  position: relative;
  max-width: 300px;
  border-radius: 8px;
  overflow: hidden;
  box-shadow: 0 2px 8px rgba(0,0,0,0.15);
}
.gallery-img {
  display: block;
  width: 100%;
  height: 100%;
  object-fit: cover;
}
.gallery-overlay {
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  text-align: center;
  padding: 1rem;
  background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.6);
  color: #fff;
  font-size: 1rem;
  opacity: 0;
  transition: opacity 0.2s ease;
}
.gallery-item:hover .gallery-overlay,
.gallery-item:focus .gallery-overlay,
.gallery-item:focus-within .gallery-overlay {
  opacity: 1;
}
</style>
